title: Invert Binary Tree
statement: Mirror the tree: swap the left and right child of every node. Return the root.

hints.1_question: Each node's children swap places. What about the nodes inside those children?
hints.2_nudge: Recursively invert the left and right subtrees, then swap them (or swap first then recurse).

known_bugs.name: swaps only the root's children
known_bugs.followup: After swapping the root's children, what about the children's own children?

known_bugs.name: never inverts the right subtree
known_bugs.followup: The old left subtree becomes the right child. Is it inverted too?

known_bugs.name: second assignment uses the already-overwritten left child
known_bugs.followup: After the first line, what does root.left point to? Is that still the original left subtree?

followups: How would you do it iteratively with a queue or stack?
Why does the order of the two assignments matter?
